verdict.rationale: Xero provides an official MCP server and AI Toolkit (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, prompt examples) exposing ledger data like contacts, chart of accounts, and invoices via standardized API access, which could ground an agent's answer to affordability questions. However, there's no direct evidence of a built-in conversational agent answering 'can we afford X' with live financial analysis—this requires developers to build the integration themselves using the provided tools rather than an out-of-box capability.
